newsitem.title: USA: Alliance consolidation plan on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Alliance consolidation plan on schedule.

text.p: Alliance Entertainment Corp chairman and chief executive officer Al Teller, said Thursday the company's consolidation plan was on schedule for completion during the first quarter of 1998.

Teller made the statement as the independent music company reported a net loss of $23.1 million or $0.52 a share for the first quarter of 1997, against a net loss of $4.6 million or $0.13 a share the year-ago quarter.
The company reported sales of $126.3 million for the 1997 quarter, compared with $176.2 million in the 1996 quarter.
Teller said the results in the latest quarter "continue to reflect the company's struggle to complete its consolidation plan in light of difficult industry conditions that persisted" in the period.
Teller said Alliance should be able to successfully address the current financial and industry pressures, especially in light of the continued support of the company's banks and suppliers.
